readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order (caption, TV label, caption, nurse's balloon, caption, tablet label) matches the script exactly, and their tail and coverage findings for 04-2 agree with mine. Their ambiguities: (1) The unnamed nurse: her lavender scrubs, lanyard and the vitals equipment establish her role, the source names her only as 'Nurse', and her line names Ravi. Acceptable. (2) 'Just relax your arm' after the cuff is on: the moment is just before she squeezes the bulb, so asking him to relax is natural and the line is the user-approved r13 wording. Acceptable. (3) The 'RAVI · READY' box looking pasted on and reaching the bezel: confirmed that its lower edge extends slightly onto the bezel. The raw art shows that it sits on the drawn notification card under the check icon. It is legible, covers no fingers or face, and the source places this label on the tablet. I judge it a minor stylistic point that does not mislead or hide anything, not a lettering defect that needs correction. (4) 'NOW · A-12' confirming Ravi as A-12 is the intended link to page 03. The new page 05 boundary works, as described in the 04-3 to 05-1 transition. Nothing is unresolved.
